# getjinai.com

> getjinai.com handles sales for Jin AI and is operated by Jin AI. Jin AI is an AI assistant for teams. It spots repetitive work in the email, calendar, chat, and files a team connects, prepares drafts such as meeting briefs, status updates, and replies, and learns from each approval, edit, or skip. It never sends anything without a person's approval. Customer data is not used to train AI models. The official site is https://jinai.md/.

## Pages

- [Get Jin AI for Your Team | AI Assistant That Prepares Repetitive Work](https://getjinai.com/): Get Jin AI, the AI assistant that spots repetitive work in email, calendar, and chat and prepares drafts for review. Compare ways to start, setup services, and answers for IT.
- [Jin AI for Teams: Product Details, Specifications, and Q&A | getjinai](https://getjinai.com/jin-ai-for-teams/): Jin AI for Teams prepares briefs, updates, and replies before they are needed. See specifications, admin controls, privacy, and answers to common questions.

## Key facts

- Works with: Gmail, Outlook, Google Calendar, Slack, Microsoft Teams
- Output: drafts for review (briefs, agendas, updates, replies)
- Admin controls: choose teams and tools; exclude folders, channels, labels, or teams
- Privacy: findings go to the employee, not their manager; no scoring or ranking of people; each company's data kept separate
- How to start: one team and one repetitive task (pilot)
- Demo and contact: https://jinai.md/ (hello@jinai.md)
